name: Star Shot (Combat)
body:
An ancient aqua ball technique passed down from the previous champions.

Prerequisite(s): Weapon Focus (aqua ball), base attack bonus +7

When hitting a target with an aqua ball during a full attack, you may choose to treat their space as the origin for a single subsequent attack, determining range from their space instead of your own.
